country.evidence_quote: In 2019, Ellie Zimmerman was a high school sophomore who couldn't find a meaningful internship. Instead of giving up, she built one — for herself and for thousands of students who came after her. What started as a simple idea grew into a national nonprofit serving 350+ organizations across the U.S.
